notes: Streaming albums for the planned shows. tencent = v.qq.com cover id (cid); null when Tencent has no TV album of its own, then provider names the fallback. verified = read from the platform's JSON API; otherwise from search results only. IMDb counts come from the official datasets (title.episode / title.ratings) downloaded on the survey date.

apis.tencentSearch: POST https://pbaccess.video.qq.com/trpc.videosearch.mobile_search.MultiTerminalSearch/MbSearch?vplatform=2 (15-char ids starting with sdp are whole-web-search pointers to other sites, not Tencent albums)
apis.tencentEpisodes: node tools/fetch-tencent-episodes.js <cid> <out.json> (albums over 600 episodes need the page_context tabs that the episode list returns)
apis.youkuSearch: https://so.youku.com/search/q_<title> (JS-rendered; gives showid and episode count only)
